findings.title: Escape in the open item-type menu also closes the line drawer around it
findings.evidence: ItemTypePicker handles Escape only in the input's React onKeyDown (`if (e.key === 'Escape') { close(); return; }`) and registers no layer with useEscapeKey. The Escape stack listens on window (lib/useEscapeKey.ts onKey), so the same press also dispatches the top registered layer: the page's drawer handler (`setActiveIdx(null)` / `setEditing(null)`). Combobox.tsx:81-85 fixed exactly this by registering `useEscapeKey(() => setOpen(false), open)`; ItemTypePicker was written as a sibling and never got it.
findings.failure_scenario: On desktop New PO / Edit PO / Box check, a purchaser adds an Other line, types in Item type and presses Escape to dismiss the suggestions. The menu closes and so does the whole line drawer, taking them out of the line they were filling in (values typed so far stay on the line, but the drawer and its focus are gone).
findings.proposed_fix: Register the open menu as an Escape layer the way Combobox does: `useEscapeKey(close, open)` and drop the Escape branch from onKeyDown.
findings.regression_test: Render ItemTypePicker inside a component that registers useEscapeKey(onOuter); open the menu, dispatch keydown Escape on the input; expect the menu closed and onOuter not called. A second Escape calls onOuter.

findings.title: Sortable table headers cannot be reached or operated from the keyboard
findings.location: apps/frontend/src/components/SortTh.tsx:35-46 (used by pages/desktop/DesktopOrders.tsx, InventoryProductTable.tsx, TrackerAnalytics.tsx, FleetWorkers.tsx, fleet/FleetAccountsTab.tsx)
findings.evidence: SortTh puts the sort action on a bare `<th onClick>` with no tabIndex, no role and no key handler; the caret is aria-hidden. aria-sort is set, but nothing focusable exists to change it.
findings.failure_scenario: A keyboard or screen-reader user on the PO list or the inventory product table can Tab through the page but never lands on a column header, so the lists cannot be re-sorted without a mouse.
findings.proposed_fix: Wrap the header content in a `<button type="button">` that calls onSort (keeping aria-sort on the th), the usual sortable-table pattern.
findings.regression_test: Render SortTh, focus it via Tab, press Enter and Space: onSort is called with the column each time.

findings.title: Refine panel's Clear all control is nested inside the header button
findings.evidence: The panel header is a `<button>` and the Clear all control is a `<span role="button" tabIndex={0}>` inside it. The HTML content model forbids interactive or tabindexed descendants of a button; browsers and screen readers flatten a button's children into its name, so the inner control is announced as part of 'Refine… Clear all Hide' and is not exposed as its own button.
findings.failure_scenario: On Inventory and WeChat price board, a screen-reader user hears one toggle button whose name includes 'Clear all'; activating it toggles the panel instead of clearing the filters. Clear all is only reliably usable with a mouse.
findings.proposed_fix: Move Clear all out of the header button (a sibling button in a flex row), keeping stopPropagation unnecessary.
findings.regression_test: Accessibility-tree check: the header exposes two separate buttons; activating Clear all via keyboard calls onClear and not onOpen.

findings.title: [carryover UI-05] PO timeline still prints English stage and field names in Chinese
findings.evidence: UI-05 moved the titles to t(), but the values inside them still come from English tables: `LIFECYCLE_LABEL` is `LIFECYCLE_STATUS` (stage labels like 'In Transit'), and `changeLine` uses `fieldLabel()` over the English `FIELD_LABEL` map ('Qty', 'Unit cost'). The zh template `acAdvancedTitle: '推进 {from} → {to}'` is filled with English. `poStageName(slug, t)` already exists for this. PhNotificationsSheet also keeps a private relTime returning 'now', '5m', '3h', '2d' while lib/format.ts exports a locale-aware relTime.
findings.failure_scenario: A manager using Chinese opens a PO's Activity: rows read '推进 In Transit → Reviewing' and 'Qty: 4 → 8'; the revert notice shows 'Reviewing → Draft'. The phone notification sheet shows English relative times.
findings.proposed_fix: Use poStageName(slug, t) for advanced/reverted/revert-notice stages, give FIELD_LABEL i18n keys (as SellOrderHistory's FIELD_KEY already does), and use lib/format relTime in PhNotificationsSheet.
findings.regression_test: Render advanced, reverted and line_edited events and RevertNoticeDialog under zh; assert no English stage or field label appears.

findings.title: Sell-order History card stays on 'Loading…' forever when its fetch fails
findings.evidence: The effect's catch only calls handleFetchError(e); `events` stays null, so the card renders t('historyLoading') indefinitely with no error state or retry. The catch is also not gated on `cancelled`, so a failure for an order the user already left still raises an error toast/dialog.
findings.failure_scenario: A transient 5xx or network drop on GET /api/sell-orders/:id/events leaves the History card on 'Loading…' for the rest of the visit; the user cannot tell the audit trail failed to load rather than being slow.
findings.proposed_fix: Keep an error state, render a failed message with a retry, and gate the catch on `cancelled`.
findings.regression_test: Mock api.get to reject; expect a failure message (not historyLoading) and a retry button that refetches.

findings.title: Phone password sheet closes on a backdrop tap even while saving, discarding typed passwords
findings.evidence: The Cancel button is `disabled={saving}`, but the sheet passes `onBackdrop={onClose}` unguarded. Every other busy sheet in the lane (PhAccountingSheet:52, PhHandoffSheet:19, PhCommissionSheet:128, PhVoidSheet:190) guards the backdrop with `if (!busy)`.
findings.failure_scenario: A user types current, new and confirm passwords on the phone and grazes the dimmed area above the sheet (or taps it while Save is in flight). The sheet closes and all three fields are lost; mid-save, the request still completes and the success toast appears for a sheet that is already gone.
findings.proposed_fix: `onBackdrop={() => { if (!saving) onClose(); }}`, and consider ignoring the backdrop once any field is non-empty.
findings.regression_test: Render the sheet, start a save with a pending promise, fire the backdrop handler: onClose is not called.

findings.title: Phone 'Follow system language' switch exposes no on/off state
findings.evidence: The switch is a plain `<button aria-label={t('langSystem')}>` whose state is only the CSS class `on`; it has no role="switch"/aria-checked or aria-pressed. The language rows likewise show selection only by a check icon, with no aria-pressed or radio semantics.
findings.failure_scenario: VoiceOver reads 'Follow system, button' whether the switch is on or off, so a blind user cannot tell what Done will save; the same holds for which language row is selected.
findings.proposed_fix: Add role="switch" aria-checked={followSystem} to the toggle, and role="radio" aria-checked on the language rows inside a radiogroup.
findings.regression_test: Accessibility-tree check: the toggle reports checked/unchecked and each language row reports its selection.
